app.name: Homa
app.tagline: Find the day that works for everyone.

auth.firstUserNote: The first account on this Homa becomes its admin.
auth.name: Name
auth.forgotNoEmail: Forgot your password? Ask the admin of this Homa to reset it for you.
auth.forgotIntro: Enter the email address you sign in with, and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If an account uses {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. It works once, for 1 hour. If it hasn't arrived in a few minutes, check your spam folder.
auth.forgotUnavailable: This Homa can't send email, so it can't send reset links. Ask its admin to reset your password for you.
auth.sendFailed: That didn't work. Wait a minute, then try again.
auth.resetDone: Your password is changed, and you're signed out on your other devices. Sign in with the new one.
auth.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.checkEmail: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm your address and finish creating your account. The link works for 1 hour.
auth.resent: A new link is on its way.
auth.notConfirmed: Confirm your email address before you sign in. We just sent a new link to {{email}}.
auth.verified: Thanks, your email address is confirmed.
auth.verifyExpired: This confirmation link has expired. Enter your email address to get a new one.
auth.verifyInvalid: This confirmation link isn't valid, perhaps because it was cut short. Enter your email address to get a new one.
auth.invitedBy: {{name}} invited you to {{instance}}. Make your account below.
auth.inviteUnusable: This invite link has expired or has already been used. Ask for a new one.

setup.title: Set up your Homa
setup.intro: This Homa is new. Make the admin account, check how the instance works, then choose your own settings.
setup.accountIntro: This account runs the instance: it can change the settings in the next step at any time.
setup.instanceIntro: These apply to everyone on this Homa. The defaults suit most people; you can change them later under Settings.
setup.personalIntro: Now your own settings. Everyone who joins later chooses theirs too.
setup.done: All set. Your Homa is ready.
setup.codeHint: The 4 digits Homa printed in its server log when it started (look for "first-run setup code").

signUpsOption.open: Anyone who can reach this Homa

signUpsHint.open: The sign-in page links to sign-up.
signUpsHint.closed: The sign-up page only opens from an invite link. Invite people under Settings → People.

instance.defaultLanguageHint: Used until someone picks a language on their device.
instance.defaultsHint: New accounts start with this; each person can change their own.
instance.oidcHint: Configured from the environment only (HOMA_OIDC_*). See the self-hosting sign-in guide.

instance.oidcOff: Off — set HOMA_OIDC_ISSUER, HOMA_OIDC_CLIENT_ID and HOMA_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET to turn it on.

importExport.title: Import and export
importExport.importHint: Add events from an .ics file exported from Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar or another app. Importing the same file again updates those events.
importExport.exportHint: Download your settings, calendars and events as a JSON file, for a backup or to move to another Homa.

connections.title: Connected calendars
connections.hint: Subscribe to a calendar feed (an .ics or webcal address from Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, a sports team or a school), add public holidays, or connect a CalDAV account (iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud), a Google account or a Microsoft account (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365) to sync both ways.
connections.urlHint: An https or webcal link ending in .ics. Private links are stored encrypted.
connections.name: Name
connections.nameHint: Optional. Leave empty to use the calendar's own name.
connections.removeBody: "{{name}}" and its events will be removed from Homa. The original calendar isn't changed.
connections.missing: "{{name}}" was deleted on {{provider}}, or is no longer shared with this account.
connections.removeMissingBody: Remove "{{name}}" and its events from Homa?

caldav.title: Connect a CalDAV account

hints.icloud: Use an app-specific password from account.apple.com, not your Apple Account password.
hints.fastmail: Create an app password for CalDAV under Settings → Privacy & Security in Fastmail.
hints.mailbox: Create an app password in your mailbox.org security settings and use it instead of your mailbox.org password.
hints.posteo: Create an app password in your Posteo settings and use it instead of your Posteo password. The user name is your full Posteo address.
hints.zoho: Create an app-specific password in your Zoho account's security settings (required when two-factor authentication is on). The user name is your Zoho email address. If your account is in another region, change .com in the address, for example to .eu.
hints.nextcloud: Your server's address followed by /remote.php/dav, for example https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav. Create an app password under Settings → Security.
hints.other: The address of your CalDAV server. Homa also tries /.well-known/caldav on it.

caldav.passwordHint: Stored encrypted. Homa never shows it again.
caldav.chooseHint: Checked calendars sync both ways. Unchecking one removes it from Homa only, not from the server.
caldav.noCalendars: This account has no calendars with events.
caldav.removeBody: "{{name}}" and its calendars will be removed from Homa. Nothing on the server is changed.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.hint: Pick a color for each calendar, and choose which ones show in the calendar views. Hidden calendars keep syncing.
calendars.suggested: The swatches above stay readable in light and dark themes.

reminders.title: What to remind you of

channels.hint: Reminders always show in the bell. Channels also send them to your email, phone or other apps.
channels.noEmail: Email isn't set up on this server.
channels.name: Name
channels.emailHint: Reminders go to your account's email address.

tasks.noTags: Tags you add to tasks show here.
tasks.addHint: Type a date or time to set when it's due. Press Enter to add it.
tasks.emptyInbox: Your Inbox is empty. Tasks without a project land here.
tasks.emptyProject: No open tasks in this project.

todoist.title: Import from Todoist
todoist.hint: In Todoist, open a project's menu and choose Export as a template, then Export as a CSV file. On Pro, Settings → Backups gives a ZIP with a CSV per project: unzip it and choose all the files. Each file becomes a project named after it (or goes into the project with that name). Importing again skips tasks that are already there. Completed tasks aren't in Todoist's export.
todoist.summary: Tasks added: {{imported}}. Already there: {{skipped}}. New projects: {{createdProjects}}.
todoist.unreadDates_one: {{count}} due date couldn't be read. Its text is in the task's notes.
todoist.unreadDates_other: {{count}} due dates couldn't be read. Their text is in the tasks' notes.
todoist.sections_one: {{count}} section was left out (Homa has no sections). Its tasks were imported.
todoist.sections_other: {{count}} sections were left out (Homa has no sections). Their tasks were imported.

people.title: People
people.hint: Invite family and friends to this Homa, and group them into circles to share calendars with.

invites.title: Invites
invites.hint: An invite link lets one person make an account here, even when sign-ups are closed. It works once, for 7 days.
